description: The score of one contract as JSON: composite and sub-scores, whether it is stale, when it was pushed and read, the oracle and block it was read at, and a `cast call` to replay the reading. A value not read is null and named in `not_read`, never 0.

chain.description: robinhood, ethereum-l1, arbitrum, base, tempo, plasma, monad, hyperliquid or solana

name: getScore
